source_name_ch1: gastrocnemius muscles of 3 month old mice after exercise

flags.note: the stop reason says no exercise arm, yet these values carry exercise words

stop_claims.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: all 9 sequenced mice (5 Gprc6a fl/fl, 4 Gprc6a_Mck-/-) were sampled after exercise and no sedentary/rest arm was sequenced, so the effect of exercise on gene expression is not identifiable. The only available contrast is genotype within exercised mice (the paper's RNA-seq estimand), which is not an exercise effect.
